A [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''impostor''' posed as the [[Lost Prince]], a famous prince who was kidnapped from the royal family of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] as a child some twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic War]]. The impostor was in fact the son of one of the original kidnappers, and after his ruse was exposed, the man confirmed that the real prince had died shortly after his kidnapping.
